name: vibe-prompt
description: Audit, organize, classify, grade, and evolve the LLM prompts shipped in your app. Static inventory + 7-smell audit (F1-F7) + behavioral drift testing with 4-dimension scoring + monotonic baseline regression tracking + creative discovery of new prompts. /vibe-prompt:scan inventories every prompt site; /vibe-prompt:audit fires structural findings with per-prompt scores (schema tightness, persona consistency, instruction clarity, token efficiency); /vibe-prompt:eval runs prompts against the prod model and an in-session Claude baseline with SWRS + Long CoT + Swap-and-Discard calibration, surfacing semantic drift with explicit evaluator-bias caveats; /vibe-prompt:grade synthesizes audit + eval scores into per-prompt + app composite grades and tracks regression vs monotonic baseline; /vibe-prompt:iterate discovers new prompts your app could add via creative-divergent LLM call (~$0.02) with handoff hints to /vibe-cartographer:scope or /vibe-iterate:feature-add; /vibe-prompt:radar tracks what's new in the model space for your vendors. TS/JS + Python coverage. Env-var-only key handling; composes with vibe-sec. Validated on Celestia3 (Next.js + Firebase + Gemini).
